name: EmDash Plugins
action: Build a useful CMS integration, validate its manifest and publish using an Atmosphere account. Include accurate author and website metadata.
note: Publishing documented; listing acceptance and link attributes still need checking.

name: Make
requires: Tested custom app for your API
action: Build a connection and useful modules. Test real scenarios, then request app review. Plan for ongoing support.
note: Review required before the app is available to all users.

name: Firefox Add-ons
action: Package and test your extension, provide source and reproducible build instructions where required, and submit for signing and public distribution.
note: Porting a Chrome extension still requires compatibility and policy checks.

name: ChatGPT plugin directory
action: Prepare the plugin ZIP, upload it through the platform, resolve automated findings and submit for review. Connect and test your MCP server if included.
note: Current submission docs differ from the original post. Approval is required; citation preference is not established.

name: n8n
action: Build and test nodes and credentials. Publish to npm using GitHub Actions with provenance, then submit through the Creator Portal for verification.
note: An npm package alone is not a verified n8n listing.

name: Microsoft Edge Add-ons
action: Register in Partner Center, upload your package and complete store, privacy and certification details. Submit for review.
note: Test your Chromium extension in Edge before submitting it.

name: Notion Marketplace
action: Build a useful workflow for Notion users. Choose the appropriate installation scope when creating the public connection, then complete Marketplace security review.
note: Public connections can exist without Marketplace approval; those are different milestones.

name: Fern Agent Score
action: Assess your documentation with Agent Score and improve readability, discovery and authentication access. Check whether a public report is available for your submission.
note: Assessment tool confirmed. The thread’s public-report backlink claim was not independently verified.

name: Postman API Network
requires: Public API collection and team profile
action: Make your team profile public, create a public workspace and publish useful API collections and examples. Remove credentials before sharing.
note: A public team profile appears on the API Network. Confirm your website link on the published profile.

name: Chrome Web Store
action: Register a developer account, upload the extension ZIP and complete listing, privacy and test instructions. Submit for review.
note: Registration may involve a fee. The directory is free to use; not every opportunity is free to execute.

name: npm
action: Package a useful API client or CLI with a clear README, homepage and repository. Test it, configure secure publishing and publish a public package.
note: Libraries.io and npm.io aggregate packages. Extra listings are not guaranteed or separate submissions.

name: RapidAPI
action: Create an API Project in Studio, import your API specification and complete the Hub Listing. Check current access, authentication and commercial settings before making it public.
note: Do not assume the post’s free-plan or bring-your-own-key setup fits every API.

name: ClawHub
action: Prepare instructions that explain a real product workflow, authentication and safe use. Review current publisher and moderation requirements before uploading.
note: Registry confirmed. Exact commands, no-review claims and backlink treatment remain unverified.

name: Smithery
action: Prepare clear tool descriptions and a product homepage. Use the current publishing flow and test connectivity and authentication after listing.
note: Platform has changed since the post; recheck gateway and authentication instructions rather than copying them.

name: Glama
requires: Working MCP server or public repository
action: Find an existing listing or submit your server. Verify ownership where available, document authentication and check the listing’s health and tool descriptions.
note: Directory confirmed. Registry ingestion timing and link attributes are not guaranteed.

name: Official MCP Registry
action: Prepare accurate server metadata and use the registry’s publishing documentation to authenticate ownership and publish a version.
note: A registry entry is distribution metadata; downstream directory links are not guaranteed.

name: Claude community directory
action: Check the directory management page in your account for current eligibility and submission options before building around this opportunity.
note: Needs verification: account-gated route. The author reports a noindex page; do not count this as an indexed SEO backlink.

name: Vercel Connect
action: Review the connector catalogue and onboarding route. Describe the product clearly and provide the authentication and connection details requested.
note: Catalogue confirmed. Approval time and acceptance are not guaranteed.

name: Zapier
action: Use the developer platform to build and test your app’s triggers and actions, then follow the public integration review route.
note: Do not confuse connecting to Zapier MCP with getting your own app publicly listed.
